prompt:

Asset type: Grave Accord Tethered Traverse equipment emblem.
Input image 1 is the edit target. Preserve the complete dark iron gun cradle, brass hinge/clamp and short stitched leather control loop, their exact practical construction, painted materials, restrained palette and readable silhouette.
Primary request: produce a clean native RGBA cutout on a genuinely transparent square background. Every empty pixel around and between the assembly must have alpha exactly zero, especially all four corners and the entire outer margin. Keep all solid metal and leather fully opaque. Remove the near-transparent residue in the empty background.

Constraints: no background colour, ground plane, shadow, halo, haze, glow, particles, frame, text, arrows, extra gun or new objects. Preserve the original object and its dry painted finish; only its clean transparency and framing need correction.
